I can freely rate them as I have done based on my experience.  I do not downgrade the comments of the other reviews but I am expressing this based on my personal experience. The doctors and nurses have understood my complex issues and addressed them as best as they could given the prevailing circumstances and stringent NHS budgets.  The reception staff work under pressure too but I have learnt to get my details in order before I call the practice.

The idea of an online form is brilliant because it saves me so much time.  I usually get feedback in good time.  In case of an emergency I just call 111 or the practice and take it from the advice I am given.

Even during the peak of the pandemic I always got help when I needed it.  Ofcourse one can come across some misunderstanding here and there but these issues can be resolved if we as human beings discuss our issues together.   I can choose not to deal with particular individuals if need be.  After all, this is our practice and the staff are there for us.  Mutual understanding and respect goes both ways.

The practice used to operate from a small building but realised the value of expanding the premises to create an open space which is very welcoming.   I can recommend this practice to anyone without concern.  I help other people who go to different practices with solving their medical issues.
What I have seen in other practices has made me appreciate my practice more and more.

Thank you for your message. We have adopted a new way of digital triage to try and cope with the large number of requests that we get each day. This is to try and ensure that we can help the most number of patients each day and stop the long call waits on the phones in the morning. Sometimes in order to triage requests, we do need more information. This is so that we can tell the best type of appointment to offer you or whether you could be better helped by another type of clinician or whether we can sort the issue without an appointment. We have safety features built into the system so that had you not responded to our email, this would have been flagged to us and we would have phoned you by the end of the day.  The change in our appointment system has meant that on average, we have appointments to offer people for 2 hours more each day, has dramatically reduced the average call time to the surgery and has increased the number of people that we can help each day.

truly believe that the best thing anyone can do who is unfortunate enough to be a patient here, is to immediately look for a new GP practice. I genuinely don’t know what’s worse; the attitude of the GPs, or the receptionists. Worse still, they’re in denial that they’re ever rude - yet the sheer number of complaints and bad reviews seems to suggest otherwise. I’d avoid this medical centre if you value your health, both physical and mental.

Also worth mentioning is that during my time as a patient, I had to report the practice to the Information Commissioner, because they handed me an envelope with my name on; which contained the entire and complete medical notes of an elderly lady from my area who I have no connection to and do not know. I was shocked to find out that I have cancer... until I realised I was reading somebody else’s notes! This was just one incident out of a catalogue of failures that their practice manager failed to discuss with me (in fact, she claimed she’d met with me and resolved my problems — yet I’ve never once met her). The incompetence of this practice is borderline dangerous.
